channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Public Telegram channels: usernames or links. Any of these work: durov, @durov, https://t.me/durov, https://t.me/s/durov, https://t.me/durov/123. Private channels, invite links (t.me/+...) and groups are not supported.

maxPostsPerChannel.title: Max posts per channel
maxPostsPerChannel.description: Stop after this many posts for each channel, newest first. Each post is billed as one event.

sinceDate.title: Only posts since
sinceDate.description: Only posts published on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO timestamp, or relative like "24 hours", "7 days" or "1 month". Scraping stops when older posts are reached, so scheduled runs only pay for new posts.

includeChannelInfo.title: Include channel info
includeChannelInfo.description: Add one item per channel with its title, description, exact subscriber count, photo and media counters. Billed as one channel-info event per channel.

onlyNew.title: Only new posts (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only posts not returned by an earlier run with the same channels. Schedule the actor (e.g. hourly or daily) for new-post alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new posts and stop reading each channel after 3 known posts in a row. State is kept in the key-value store "telegram-channel-scraper-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed for normal volumes. Use Apify Proxy for very large runs if Telegram starts rate-limiting.
